## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

The retry limit must be corrected before merge: persistent upstream failures trigger ten attempts, exceeding the project’s required maximum of five.

## Critical
- app/net.py:13 — correctness — When the upstream consistently raises `OSError`, the default call makes ten attempts instead of stopping at five. `AGENTS.md:5` requires: “Retry helpers under app/ must cap attempts at 5.” Set the default and validation ceiling to five, and align the docstring and tests with that limit. — During an upstream outage, each default call makes twice the permitted number of requests, increasing upstream load and caller wait time.

(none)

(none)

## Strengths
- Exhaustion re-raises the upstream exception, and tests exercise that behavior.
- The single-attempt test verifies that failure does not trigger a sleep.
